Name: Billie Eilish as Abigail (DEMO)
Author: themjalt
Description:
(NOT COMPLETED!!)

Are you obsessed with Billie Eilish (or you just want to add a celebrity to your game)? This in-development mod replaces Abigail with the one and only Billie Eilish Pirate Baird O'Connell! As of now, this mod features limited changes including a new sprite design, a new portrait, and custom Billie-themed dialogue! This mod does include swearing as seen in Billie's phrases, so please be careful! Also, as the demo model, none of the others' characters relationships with her have changed (ex: Pierre is still her father, Caroline is her mother, etc.)



CURRENT FEATURES:
- (Limited) new sprite design for walking
- new portrait
- name viewed as "Billie"
- custom dialogue


COMING IN THE FUTURE:
- revised rooms (in Pierre's and when married)
- full sprite redo (for inside of the cave)
- Pierre to be revised as Finneas
- Caroline to be revised as Claudia
